_readme: Word classes: one meaning, every spelling this market uses for it.
Person-independent, which is why it sits in sources/ beside professions.json. It is
NOT a second copy of the keyword tables - it is the define-once layer above them: a
class names a meaning, and the words in it are the spellings a posting may use. The
intended wiring is to widen the tables that already exist at load time (load_vocab's
keywords, the profile's tags, and the weighted fit/score tables), so a synonym
inherits the weight of whichever word of the class is already in that table, and no
table gains a meaning it did not already have.
THIS FILE IS THE SCORE, since 2026-09-22. A posting is labelled with every class
it names (`skills` on the corpus row), and both numbers a profile puts against a
class - expertise and importance - are paid out over those labels: 100 points split
by criticality over what one posting asks for. The `title` and `professions` axes are read
separately, to widen a profile's target titles into every other name for that job.
axis  - which vocabulary the class is meant to widen: professions, domains, tags,
title (a job-title alias, which is a different thing from a word synonym),
or one of the five skill sections:
managerial - leading people and delivery: agile, project management,
governance, mentorship, hiring, culture, OKRs.
personal   - traits and how you work with others: proactive, curious,
communication, negotiation, stakeholder management.
knowledge  - Industry Knowledge (LinkedIn's name): a concept, pattern,
field or regulation tied to no one product - system design,
DDD, monorepo, microservices, CI/CD, GMP, MDR, payments.
technical  - what you write or perform hands-on: languages, frameworks,
protocols (REST, GraphQL), lab techniques (PCR, HPLC).
tooling    - a branded product you log into, install or operate:
Datadog, Jira, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, SAP.
A skill class sits in exactly one section. It may be a
LIST when one meaning widens two vocabularies, which is how a class avoids
being written twice.
about   - one plain sentence on what the skill covers, shown in the skill dialog where
expertise and goal are rated. Required on every skill class (skill.test.ts).
caution - where the class is known to over-reach. A class with a caution must never be
expanded outside its axis.
except - phrases that hold one of the class's words and mean something else
("post-marketing" for marketing, "not screened by artificial intelligence" for ai).
Blanked out of the posting before this class alone is tried.
criticality - how much doing a job depends on the skill, 1-10. The 100 skill points of
both scores are split in proportion to it. Omitted, the section decides:
technical 10, tooling 8, knowledge 7, managerial 4, personal 3 (CRITICALITY
in libs-be/fetch/skill.constant.ts). Set it where the section is wrong for a class.
aliases - ids of classes merged into this one. Never matched in a posting: they re-key a
profile rating, a stored posting and a pasted CV row from the old id to this class
(skillIndex). A merge keeps the old id here forever; a profile that rated both keeps
the row with the higher expertise + importance.
Translations live in the same flat `words` list as the synonyms, in English, Spanish,
German and French. Matching is lowercase over the posting's own text, so the language of a
spelling changes nothing about what it matches and a second level of nesting would
buy a label nobody reads. A short word is left OUT rather than guarded: the cautions
record which ones and why.
A trait (personal) is matched over the whole posting body, where employers describe
themselves too - so its words are candidate-describing phrases ('sense of
responsibility', 'innovative mindset'), never the bare adjective ('responsible',
'innovative'), and each class records in `caution` what it still over-reaches into.
Matching (skill.transformer.ts buildSkills, skill.util.ts detectSkills): every token of a word of 5+
letters takes German/English endings, a 3-4 letter acronym a plural s (KPIs), a -y word
-ies; a trailing * is a stem. German suspended compounds ("Kommunikations- und
Koordinationsfähigkeit") and lists in front of a head noun ("communication and
presentation skills") are spelled out first, and the sections a posting spends on the
employer (About us, Wir bieten, Benefits...) are dropped (posting-text.util.ts dropOfferSections).
Umlaut plurals (abschlüsse) and glued compounds (stakeholdermanagement) are NOT derived:
list them. 2026-09-30: 107 classes added from an audit of 90 postings over 18 professions.
A class's FIRST word is its skill name in the CV prompt (cv.transformer.ts skillNames): keep it the plain
English name a CV would use ("microsoft office", not "vba"). Round 2 the same day: 32 more
classes and 41 renamed first words after 72 fresh postings and 36 sample CVs were checked.
v39 (2026-10-13): 20 near-duplicate classes merged into 14 (see each target's `aliases`).
v44 (2026-10-18): every skill class has an about. Owner-picked merges: presenting, passionate, team-advocacy, performance-management,
succession-planning, project-scheduling, feasibility-studies, perseverance, contract-management, confident-presence,
training-enablement folded in; innovative-mindset -> innovation, assertiveness -> confident, agile-delivery -> agile;
KPI words moved from reporting to okrs.
v46 (2026-10-29): audit of 400 postings (300 across 24 professions + 100 tool-focused) and a 3-panel review. Tools asked by name are their own tooling classes
(BIM, CNC, ECAD, Swiss ERP, Dynamics, SAP logistics, Adobe, Canva, stats software, data platforms, Power BI, Salesforce platform, support desk, legal databases...),
every official FMH medical specialty is a class, trades got technique classes (HVAC, food crafts, finishing, vehicle repair, carpentry, machine operation, truck licence),
52 near-duplicate classes folded (see aliases), KPI words moved from okrs back to reporting, and employer-text false positives pruned.

classes.about: Architectural and structural BIM / CAD software, e.g. Revit, ArchiCAD, Allplan, Vectorworks, Tekla, Cadwork, SketchUp, Rhino.
classes.caution: Bare 'bim' is a German acronym only in building postings; watch for other expansions.

classes.label: CNC controls & CAM
classes.about: CNC machine controls and CAM programming software, e.g. Heidenhain, Fanuc, Siemens Sinumerik, Mazatrol, hyperMILL, Mastercam, Esprit CAM, Edgecam, TopSolid.
classes.caution: Never bare 'fanuc' (also robots), 'esprit' (esprit d'equipe) or 'cam'. Heidenhain is also an employer.

classes.label: Electrical CAD

classes.label: Swiss ERP (Abacus / Bexio)
classes.about: Swiss SME accounting and ERP software, e.g. Abacus, Bexio, Sage 50/200, Proffix, Opacc, WinBIZ, Banana, Crésus.
classes.caution: Never bare 'sage' (sage-femme). Abacus and bexio are also employers.

classes.label: Microsoft Dynamics
classes.about: Microsoft's ERP / CRM family, e.g. Dynamics 365, Business Central, Navision (NAV), Dynamics AX / Axapta, Dynamics CRM.
classes.caution: Never bare 'dynamics' (molecular dynamics).

classes.label: SAP logistics & maintenance
classes.about: SAP's logistics and maintenance modules, e.g. SAP MM, SD, PP, WM / EWM, QM, PM.

classes.label: Adobe Creative Cloud
classes.about: Adobe's design and video apps, e.g. Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Acrobat.

classes.label: Canva
classes.about: Canva, the browser design tool for social posts, flyers and presentations.

classes.label: Statistical software
classes.about: Statistics packages, e.g. SPSS, SAS, Stata, Minitab, GraphPad Prism, JMP, EViews, WinBUGS.
classes.caution: Never bare 'sas' (French company form, airline) or 'prism'.

classes.label: Cloud data platforms
classes.about: Cloud data warehouse and lakehouse platforms, e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Trino.

classes.label: Data pipelines & orchestration

classes.label: Power BI
classes.about: Microsoft Power BI: reports, dashboards, DAX and Power BI service.

classes.label: Salesforce platform (admin / dev)
classes.about: Building on and administering Salesforce, e.g. Salesforce admin, Apex, Lightning, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud. Using Salesforce as a sales rep is CRM.
classes.caution: Salesforce is also an employer and appears in customer lists.

classes.label: Support desk tools
classes.about: Customer-support ticketing tools, e.g. Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Help Scout, Gorgias. IT service desks are ITSM.

classes.label: Legal databases
classes.about: Legal research databases, e.g. Swisslex, Weblaw, Legalis, beck-online, LexisNexis, Westlaw.

classes.label: Market-data terminals
classes.about: Financial market-data terminals, e.g. Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv Eikon / LSEG Workspace, FactSet, Capital IQ.
classes.caution: Never bare 'bloomberg' (employer intros, press mentions).

classes.label: Marketing automation
classes.about: Email and marketing automation platforms, e.g. Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, Emarsys.

classes.label: Building automation (BMS)
classes.about: Building management and automation systems, e.g. Siemens Desigo, KNX, BACnet, Gebäudeleitsystem / GLS.
classes.caution: No bare 'bms' (battery management system).

classes.label: 3D content creation
classes.about: 3D modelling, animation and texturing software, e.g. Autodesk Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, ZBrush, Houdini, Substance Painter.
classes.caution: Never bare 'maya' (a first name).

classes.label: Project scheduling software
classes.about: Project scheduling tools, e.g. Microsoft Project, Primavera P6.
classes.caution: Never bare 'primavera' (spring in Italian / Spanish).

classes.label: FEA / CFD software
classes.about: Simulation software for structures and flows, e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, COMSOL, MSC Nastran, HyperMesh.
classes.caution: Never bare 'fluent' (fluent in German).

classes.label: Test tools
classes.about: Test tooling, e.g. Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Postman, Tricentis Tosca, JMeter. Writing automated tests as a practice is test automation.

classes.label: APM / monitoring tools
classes.about: Monitoring and APM products, e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, Sentry, Dynatrace. The practice is observability.

classes.label: Heating, ventilation & plumbing installation
classes.about: Installing heating, ventilation, refrigeration and sanitary systems, e.g. Sanitärinstallateur, Heizungsinstallateur, Lüftungsanlagenbauer, chauffagiste, plumber.
classes.caution: No 'sanitär*' stem: 'sanitäre Anlagen' are restrooms in cleaning postings.

classes.label: Baking, confectionery & butchery
classes.about: Food-production trades: baker, pastry chef / confectioner, butcher (Bäcker-Konditor-Confiseur, Fleischfachmann, boulanger-pâtissier, boucher).
classes.caution: Never bare 'bäckerei' or 'metzgerei': they name employers and store departments.

classes.label: Tiling, flooring, painting & plastering
classes.about: Building finishing trades, e.g. Plattenleger, Parkettleger, Bodenleger, Maler EFZ, Gipser, carreleur, peintre en bâtiment.

classes.label: Vehicle repair & bodywork

classes.label: Carpentry & joinery
classes.about: Woodworking trades: joiner / cabinetmaker (Schreiner) and carpenter (Zimmermann), kitchen and furniture fitting.
classes.caution: Never bare 'schreiner', 'zimmermann' (surnames) or 'holzbau' (employer names).

classes.label: Machine & line operation

classes.label: Truck / bus licence (C, CE, D)
classes.about: Holding a heavy-vehicle licence (category C, C1, CE, D) and the CZV / OACP professional certificate.
classes.caution: Never bare 'permis c' (Swiss settlement permit) or bare c1 / ce (language level, CE marking).

classes.label: Social & childcare pedagogy

classes.label: Case management
classes.about: Managing individual cases through care, insurance or reintegration, e.g. Case Management, Fallführung, Eingliederung, return to work.

classes.label: Security operations (SOC)
classes.about: Detecting and responding to attacks, e.g. SIEM, EDR / XDR, threat hunting, threat intelligence, incident response, SOC work, MITRE ATT&CK.
classes.caution: Never bare 'soc' (system-on-chip, SOC 2) or 'yara' (first name, fertiliser company).

classes.label: Infection prevention & hospital hygiene
classes.about: Preventing infections in care settings, e.g. Spitalhygiene, Infektionsprävention, hand hygiene, hygiène hospitalière.

classes.label: Palliative care

classes.label: Mergers & acquisitions
classes.about: Deal work on mergers, acquisitions and divestments, e.g. M&A transactions, due diligence, post-merger integration, carve-outs.

classes.label: Customer orientation
classes.about: A service-minded, customer-oriented attitude, e.g. kundenorientiert, dienstleistungsorientiert, orienté client, service-minded.

classes.label: Intensive care
classes.about: Intensive care medicine and nursing (Intensivmedizin, Intensivpflege, ICU, soins intensifs).

classes.about: Vascular surgery (Gefässchirurgie, chirurgie vasculaire).

classes.about: Abdominal / visceral surgery (Viszeralchirurgie, chirurgie viscérale).

classes.label: Hand surgery
classes.about: Hand surgery (Handchirurgie, chirurgie de la main).

classes.label: Oral & maxillofacial surgery
classes.about: Oral, jaw and facial surgery (Mund-, Kiefer- und Gesichtschirurgie, chirurgie maxillo-faciale).

classes.label: Paediatric surgery
classes.about: Surgery in children (Kinderchirurgie, chirurgie pédiatrique).

classes.label: Ear, nose & throat (ENT)
classes.about: Oto-rhino-laryngology (HNO, ORL): ear, nose and throat medicine and surgery.

classes.label: Angiology
classes.about: Angiology / vascular medicine (Angiologie, Gefässmedizin).

classes.label: Rheumatology
classes.about: Rheumatology (Rheumatologie, rhumatologie).

classes.label: Occupational medicine
classes.about: Occupational medicine (Arbeitsmedizin, médecine du travail): workers' health, fitness-for-work assessments.

classes.label: Physical medicine & rehabilitation

classes.label: Tropical & travel medicine
classes.about: Tropical and travel medicine (Tropen- und Reisemedizin).

classes.label: Radiation oncology
classes.about: Radiation oncology / radiotherapy (Radio-Onkologie, Strahlentherapie, proton therapy).

classes.label: Nuclear medicine
classes.about: Nuclear medicine (Nuklearmedizin): PET, SPECT, radiopharmaceuticals.

classes.label: Forensic medicine
classes.about: Forensic / legal medicine (Rechtsmedizin, médecine légale).

classes.label: Child & adolescent psychiatry
classes.about: Child and adolescent psychiatry and psychotherapy (Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie, pédopsychiatrie).
